notes.title: Double-sided Aces Demo Update Log - 2025/08/20
notes.content: [h3]Fixes[/h3][p][b]Auto Button Issue[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Auto button would occasionally fly off the screen. It should now behave more stably.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Black Screen Stuck Issue[/b][/p][list][*][p]During black screen transitions, the story will now automatically proceed to the next segment without requiring extra input.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Yu Hao’s Coffee Choice[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Yu Hao’s coffee-related story branch where one of the options was not working properly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]PV Skip Function[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to skip the PV by pressing the [b]Esc[/b] key.[/p][/*][/list]
